task.title: Match nodes by label expressions with In, NotIn, Exists, and DoesNotExist operators
task.shortdesc: Define nodeSelectorTerms and matchExpressions to precisely include or exclude nodes by label logic.

step.cmd: List the node labels you need to match or exclude (for example, "env", "zone", "instance-type").
Create a "nodeSelectorTerms" array and decide whether you need multiple terms (OR) or multiple expressions (AND).
For inclusion, use "operator: In" with explicit values or "operator: Exists" when any value is acceptable.
For exclusion, use "operator: NotIn" with disallowed values or "operator: DoesNotExist" to avoid labeled nodes entirely.
Apply the manifest and validate the effective match set by comparing scheduled nodes against label expectations.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
